**8B.3 Research Note**
**Verdict:** Yes, with limits. Xi’s 2024 record shows real mobilization of the Party-state, military, and economic bureaucracy toward his preferred program, especially through central control, anti-graft enforcement, and targeted policy packages. The main limit is that this mobilization often deepened political control more than institutional capacity.

**Positive evidence**
| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `Xi personally presented the work report; the plenum adopted a major reform resolution` | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-07-18 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202407/18/content_WS669906cdc6d0868f4e8e93db.html | Top-level party-state mobilization was explicit: Xi fronted the agenda and the plenum reaffirmed `high-quality development`, `national security`, and `full Party self-governance`. | 8B.3, 8B.1, 8B.2 |
| `Budget raises central transfers for equal basic public services` | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-03-14 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202403/14/content_WS65f2f558c6d0868f4e8e5166.html | The center translated priorities into money, increasing transfers for education, social insurance, employment, and public health. | 8B.3, 8B.2 |
| `Finance ministry pushes broad-based growth agenda` | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-03-25 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202403/25/content_WS6600afebc6d0868f4e8e569e.html | The bureaucracy was directed to specific priorities like equipment renewal, consumer trade-ins, fair procurement treatment, and social spending. | 8B.3, 8B.2, 7B.9 |
| `NDRC says it will keep helping private enterprises and use feedback` | english.news.cn / Xinhua | 2024-01-10 | https://english.news.cn/20240110/78198229d70d4ad2824f8b50c3bedeee/c.html | Xi’s agenda was carried into an administrative feedback loop for private firms and entrepreneurs, showing state mobilization beyond pure rhetoric. | 8B.3, 8B.2, 7B.9 |
| `China unveils new property support measures` | Reuters | 2024-01-31 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-unveils-new-property-support-measures-amid-concerns-about-evergrande-fallout-3287774 | The state moved quickly with downpayment cuts, mortgage-floor cuts, SOE purchases, and project-completion financing to stabilize the property sector. | 8B.3, 8B.2 |
| `PBOC says it will keep policy flexible, moderate, precise and effective` | Reuters | 2024-02-08 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/chinas-central-bank-to-keep-policy-support-for-economy-3297311 | Monetary authorities publicly aligned with the leadership’s stabilization goals through liquidity and price-stability management. | 8B.3, 8B.2 |
| `Health reform package with procurement, DRG/DI, and wage reform` | english.www.gov.cn / Xinhua | 2024-06-06 | https://english.www.gov.cn/policies/latestreleases/202406/06/content_WS66619f69c6d0868f4e8e7e08.html | Xi’s preferred governance style was operationalized through concrete sectoral mechanisms in health finance, procurement, and基层 service delivery. | 8B.3, 8B.2, 7B.9 |
| `Xi’s discipline campaign was framed as strengthening discipline and cadre quality` | Xinhua / english.www.gov.cn | 2024-05-26 | https://english.www.gov.cn/news/202405/26/content_WS66533ca6c6d0868f4e8e77c0.html | Party discipline was used as an enforcement channel to align cadres with the program, and was followed by elite punishments such as Li Shangfu’s expulsion. | 8B.3, 8B.2, 7B.10 |
| `Official expulsion of a former defense minister after bribery findings` | Xinhua | 2024-06-27 | https://www.xinhuanet.com/20240627/f929f9248c9f40bc8f9afe791c6a716f/c.html | The leadership used anti-corruption enforcement against senior military elites, demonstrating coercive capacity to discipline strategically important networks. | 8B.3, 7B.10 |
| `Another senior Rocket Force officer expelled amid a broader purge` | South China Morning Post / Reuters | 2024-07-18 | https://www.scmp.com/news/china/military/article/3270993/chinas-communist-party-targets-another-pla-general-corruption-investigation?UUID=f0bc4b91-7818-4f96-bf67-aa5b46ac9395&next_article_id=3270939&tc=7&tpcc=enlz-globalimpact | Even amid purge-driven instability, Xi was still able to mobilize loyalty enforcement inside the nuclear-missile force, showing reach into the most sensitive military networks. | 8B.3, 7B.10 |

**Limits / counterevidence**
| Title | Publisher | Date | URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| `State Council law gives Party more control over the cabinet` | Reuters | 2024-03-11 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/china-passes-law-granting-communist-party-more-control-over-cabinet-3331891 | Mobilization worked by tightening Party capture of the state, which improved top-down control but reduced autonomous bureaucratic execution. | 8B.3, 8B.2, 8B.1 |
| `Premier press conference canceled` | Reuters | 2024-03-04 | https://www.investing.com/news/economy/china-cancels-premiers-press-conference-for-first-time-since-1993-3322647 | One of the few public accountability channels was removed, limiting external scrutiny of whether mobilization was working. | 8B.3, 8B.2, 7B.10 |
| `Party-led anti-graft committee in finance` | Reuters / MarketScreener | 2024-07-24 | https://hk.marketscreener.com/news/latest/China-targets-financial-sector-with-party-led-anti-graft-committee-47453350/ | The leadership did mobilize finance, but via “political supervision” and “party building,” which signals control-first governance rather than neutral implementation. | 8B.3, 8B.2, 7B.9, 7B.10 |
| `Home destocking push to bring developers little cheer` | Reuters | 2024-06-09 | https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/chinas-home-destocking-push-to-bring-developers-little-cheer-3476774 | Some flagship interventions were too small to fully move the target sector, suggesting partial effectiveness rather than fully successful mobilization. | 8B.3, 8B.2 |
| `IMF exec board concludes 2024 Article IV consult` | IMF | 2024-08-02 | https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/31/pr24295-china-imf-exec-board-concludes-2024-art-iv-consult | External assessment said growth stayed resilient but the medium-term outlook still needed a more comprehensive package, implying partial rather than complete program execution. | 8B.3, 8B.2 |
| `RFA shuts Hong Kong bureau citing security law concerns` | Reuters | 2024-03-29 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/usfunded-radio-free-asia-shuts-hong-kong-bureau-citing-security-law-concerns-3358157 | Information control and intimidation helped mobilization, but they also narrowed honest feedback and weakened the system’s ability to self-correct. | 8B.3, 7B.10, 8B.2 |

**Search gap**
- I did not find credible 2024 evidence of an independent, non-Party performance audit showing whether Xi’s coalition-building or implementation machinery was genuinely effective on its own terms.
- The strongest evidence is internal: policy directives, Party discipline, coercive enforcement, and sectoral interventions. That supports mobilization, but not open institutional resilience.
